PREDICT.condition: Strong discriminatory evidence for a single supported disease

CLARIFY.condition: Multiple in-domain diseases plausible, or contradictory information needing resolution

ABSTAIN.condition: Zero valid symptoms, purely out-of-scope conditions, unsupported symptoms, or third-party attribution

URGENT_ESCALATION.condition: Red-flag cardiac, stroke, coma, severe respiratory failure, or massive hemorrhage cues detected
